##### Project general facts

Gateway by Premier Choice is a contemporary residential building that combines a ground floor, parking podium and residential levels topped by a rooftop sports and leisure deck. The project offers studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed to maximise natural light and open space. Open balconies extend each home outdoors and frame wide views of the surrounding city, creating a private outdoor space for relaxation or entertaining. A welcoming lobby with an adjoining coffee shop sets the tone on arrival.

The amenity programme is built around an active and social lifestyle. The rooftop features an infinity pool with city views, an outdoor cinema and a padel tennis court, while an open-to-sky barbecue area, a half basketball court and landscaped seating with pergolas provide space for gatherings. Families benefit from a kids' splash pool and a dedicated learning centre for children. Residents also have access to an indoor and outdoor gym, an open-air yoga space and a residents-only co-working lounge.

Interiors are available in light and dark themes, each with its own palette of fixtures, finishes and ambient lighting across living rooms, bedrooms and bathrooms. Kitchens come in open or closed layouts, with the closed option available to all buyers. Every apartment includes a home automation system with a dedicated voice assistant, smart control panels for lighting and temperature, and digital access control by app, fingerprint, card or password. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and finished interiors, leaving loose furniture to the owner's taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a master-planned community by Nakheel at the heart of new Dubai, set among landscaped gardens and parks. It brings together villas, townhouses and apartment buildings in a quieter, family-oriented setting while keeping the city's main business and leisure districts close at hand. The circular layout is organised around green spaces, with parks, playgrounds and pet-friendly areas spread throughout the neighbourhoods.

The community sits between Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, providing quick connections to Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Hills Mall, Palm Jumeirah and Downtown Dubai. Residents have access to schools, nurseries, clinics, hospitals, supermarkets, cafes and fitness centres within the community, and Circle Mall serves as a local hub for shopping and dining.

Jumeirah Village Circle is one of the most actively traded freehold communities in Dubai, consistently ranking among the leaders in transaction volume. Strong tenant demand from young professionals and families supports high rental yields. The combination of a central position, mature infrastructure and a wide choice of homes keeps the area popular with both end users and investors.
